speaker: Ana
text:
Kim has just come back from visiting her family in Korea. Tomorrow, she’s coming over for coffee. I’ve been painting my flat all week, so I have a lot to show her. I’ve finished the living room and the kitchen, but I haven’t started the bedroom yet.

I’ve also been running every morning for two weeks. Getting up early was hard at first, but now I enjoy it. In the evenings, I’ve been baking. I’ve made three cakes this week, and I’m saving a slice for Kim.

It’s been a productive week, but I haven’t had much time for myself. This weekend, I want to take a break from painting and catch up with my friend.
